riff.title: The first Friday roll-up, drafted from the graph
riff.message:
Tanya — you ruled the roll-up into existence on Wednesday, so I took it literally: here's the first Friday one, drafted from everything the team's perspective actually holds. I couldn't help noticing the ruling is the product eating its own dog food — "instead of asking anyone to scroll back" is Tina's scroll-back problem from the March product vision, turned inward on our own reactions. So I built it the way we tell customers to build it.

---

**Friday roll-up — week of Oct 5**

**What moved**
- Cadence ruling (Tanya, Wed): the per-run bundle stays; one roll-up added on Fridays. The bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week.
- Rejected: a daily digest — most days carry a single run and it would repeat the bundle word for word.
- Pricing: the $12/user/month set back on March 10 did not hold — revised to $15. Still the one contested item on the board.

**Still open**
- The framing question under the ruling — how updates scope across per-run, daily, and weekly cadences — was answered for this case but not closed in general.
- Next sprint focus stands: context preservation, linking decisions to the context that produced them. (Identified as the #1 request from beta users.)

---

One thing the draft surfaced: the roll-up is only worth sending on weeks where something contested moved. This week that's pricing. If a week carries nothing but single runs, the roll-up has the same redundancy problem you named against the daily digest — worth a one-line rule for when the Friday roll-up skips a week.
